content:
# Guest

A park guest with an animated walk cycle, modelled from the RCT2 peep sprite. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# CoasterCar

A single wooden-coaster car with seated riders, modelled from the RCT2 vehicle sprite. Drag to orbit.

Built with three.js on top of the shared `Stage` component. The geometry is hand-modelled to match the colours and proportions of the authentic RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 sprite (its 4 rotations were used as reference).

# Kit

Scenery kit showcase: trees, bench, bin, lamp, fountain, statue and flower bed together.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# WaterTile

Animated water surface with a custom GLSL wave + Fresnel + sparkle shader.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# GrassTile

A grass land tile (textured earth slab with tufts) from the RCT2 terrain surface.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# SandTile

A sand land tile with dune ripples from the RCT2 desert surface.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# TerrainMap

A generated RCT2-style landscape: stepped grass/sand tiles flooded by the water shader.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# Carousel

Merry-go-round: spinning horses under a striped canopy, from the RCT2 sprite.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.

# FerrisWheel

Ferris wheel with A-frame supports and gondolas that stay upright as they orbit.

Built with three.js on the shared Stage; modelled from the authentic RCT2 sprite.
